description: Source code implementing flash area layout and sector retrieval functions for Zephyr OS, including callbacks and utility functions for managing flash memory regions.

methods.name: should_bail
methods.description: Determines if the flash page callback should exit early based on position and capacity constraints.

methods.name: flash_area_layout
methods.description: Generic routine to discover the layout of a flash area, supporting both current and deprecated functions.

methods.name: get_sectors_cb
methods.description: Callback to collect sector information from flash pages, with early exit conditions.

methods.name: flash_area_get_sectors
methods.description: Public API to retrieve sectors of a flash area by index.
